Nah, not nice at all.
Aug 2022
Friend was waiting for me here, arrived to a lot of meat cooked and ready to eat! Wasn't exactly in the mood for the mountain of meat, but hey hoo .....

Problem was the meat, of all kinds and all parts of the body (it looked like) just wasn't that nice......all mixed together, just throw it all on the barbie and it might work out ok.........except it didn't.... bits of a liver here, a bit of a rasher there, some fish, some ribs....I don't know, ha ha..... 
some of it was well rubbery too. 

No vegetables to sweeten the meat or lighten the load going down the hatch.

Nah, not nice at all.

Restaurant was packed, that is until midday sleeping time, I never seen a place empty as fast. We were the last out the door....ha ha

Fun Korean BBQ experience!
Dec 2017 • Family
This was a fun and different dining experience for us as the only Europeans there - the staff speak the bare minimum of English, but are lovely and keen to please regardless. We soon gathered that although it’s not a serve yourself buffet, it’s a fixed price per person and you order what you fancy from the menu and barbecue it yourself at the table using the built in coal pit. Everything was delicious and top quality, whether meat, seafood or fish. The price is incredible at under £10 a head. Only downsides: warm beer (if you’re not into diluting it with ice) and extremely noisy upstairs - although it’s clearly very popular and on this occasion it added to the ambience.

reviews.review_text:
Ajarn Mark
Bangkok, Thailand73 contributions

A nice BBQ buffet with a personal touch
Feb 2015 • Family
I was invited during the Vietnamese New Year to this place. At first, I thought it would be another regular buffet in town, however, I was very surprised to see the quality of the food and the price. Since it was a dinner on special occasion, therefore it was around VND345,000 (~$16), a value for money. Each table is served by one staff who will take your orders and then prepare BBQ for you. The only downside is that they may not speak English very well, if they speak at all. The menu has a variety of choices, beef being my favorite, is among one of them. Other menu items include chicken, lamb, deer, ostrich, seafood, pork and alligator. They also have a nice selection of pizzas and salads, all inclusive in the buffet prices. Drinks cost you between $1.2 to $2 depending on what you order. Will I ever go back there? Yes, I will go there some time in the future.
